metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Mrithyunjay
metas.description: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2026 · Gedelaraju Kakinada Taluka
metas.description: A feared rowdy-turned-politician, Gedela Raju, is murdered on the night of his political rise in Kakinada. As the investigation unfolds, seven interconnected lives-driven by secrets, ambition, and betrayal-lead back to one shocking truth behind his death.
